name: sniff
description: Token-cheap code-smell skills. A self-serve, private SonarCloud-style scan built from small skills you grow one at a time: pattern rules, AST node metrics, and file metrics that return a compact findings table instead of dumping source into the conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Token-cheap code-smell scanning for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Run every code-smell detector over a repo in one pass and get back compact findings tables instead of raw source, so an agent can audit a codebase without flooding its own context.
defaultPrompt: Use sniff to scan this repo for code smells.
Use sniff --list to show every detector available.
Use sniff --help to show every flag, subcommand, and usage example.
Use sniff to create your own code-smell detector.
